candidate_units.form: apocalypse-prescript-blessing, inaugural commission vision, and seven message-oracles
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: revelation mediation and blessing lead into lampstand commission/interpretation, then seven write-to-the-angel oracles with repeated knowledge, call, hearing, and overcoming frames
candidate_units.preference_basis: The commission and lampstand interpretation frame the seven separately preserved but collectively addressed oracles; the open-heaven throne reset begins at 4:1.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting titles, speaker shifts, cities, images, or promises can choose Christology, angel/church identity, local history, church-age chronology, ecclesiology, referents, readings, doctrine, or theology.

candidate_units.form: throne-scroll-Lamb worship vision, six seals, sealing/multitude interlude, and seventh-seal silence
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: open-heaven throne and hymns lead to sealed-scroll search/Lamb/acclamations, six openings and standing-question, sealing/multitude answer, then seventh-seal silence
candidate_units.preference_basis: Throne authority, scroll transfer, seal cycle, interlude answering who-can-stand, and seventh-seal closure form one larger vision-cycle parent while preserving scene alternatives.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomizing hymns, horsemen, tribe list, multitude, wrath, or silence can select identity, chronology, recapitulation, Israel/church systems, liturgy, fulfillment, referents, doctrine, or theology.

candidate_units.form: incense/trumpet preparation, six trumpets and woes, scroll/temple/witness interludes, and seventh-trumpet worship/temple opening
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: seven trumpeters receive instruments; incense and fire prepare four compact soundings, eagle woes frame fifth/sixth, mighty-angel scroll and temple/witness scenes intervene, seventh trumpet closes in worship and opened temple
candidate_units.preference_basis: Preparation, numbered soundings, woe transition, interludes, and seventh-trumpet acclamation belong to one cycle parent; 8:1 remains the seal closure and 12:1 begins a great-sign reset.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating plagues, locust king, Euphrates, little scroll, temple, witnesses, days, resurrection, or ark can create referent, geography, chronology, political, angel/demon, ecclesial, fulfillment, recapitulation, or system claims.

candidate_units.form: woman-dragon-child sign conflict, heavenly war/hymn/pursuit, two beasts, Lamb/144,000, angel proclamations, beatitude, and two harvests
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: great sign begins woman/dragon conflict and war; dragon pursuit issues in sea/land beasts; Lamb company and angel proclamations counterframe the beasts before harvest/vintage scenes
candidate_units.preference_basis: Sign-conflict, dragon delegation, beast visions, Lamb company, counter-proclamations, and harvests form a sustained symbolic conflict movement without requiring chronological or referential resolution.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomization can identify woman/child/dragon/beasts/mark/144,000/Babylon/harvest, choose 666/616, calculate dates/persons, impose empire or end-time policy, or select chronology, recapitulation, doctrine, or theology.

candidate_units.form: bowl sign-prelude, victory song/temple, seven-bowl cycle, Armageddon interjection, and seventh-bowl theophany
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: another great sign announces seven plagues; glass/song/temple prepare the pour command, seven announcements/results include justice speeches and watch saying, and it-is-done closes in theophany
candidate_units.preference_basis: The sign, song, sanctuary commissioning, numbered bowls, interjected watch saying, gathering, and final theophany constitute one complete cycle parent.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Splitting Moses/Lamb song, kings, spirits, Armageddon, Babylon, islands, hail, or first-person saying can select geography, nations, beings, speakers, chronology, fulfillment, military/imperial policy, doctrine, or system.

candidate_units.form: woman/beast vision and interpretation, Babylon fall oracle, separation voice, three lament groups, symbolic action, heavenly hallelujahs, marriage supper, and worship correction
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: bowl angel invites vision and interprets its riddles; fall proclamation and come-out voice lead to royal/merchant/mariner laments and millstone sign; heavenly liturgy answers and closes at angel dialogue
candidate_units.preference_basis: Vision, angelic interpretation, fall/lament catalogue, symbolic confirmation, and heavenly response form one Babylon judgment-to-celebration movement; open heaven at 19:11 resets to the rider scene.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating woman, beast heads/kings, city, luxury trades, one-hour refrain, marriage, or worship correction can identify Rome or another polity/person, calculate rulers, authorize withdrawal/economic/empire policy, or select chronology/system/doctrine.

candidate_units.form: rider/armies vision, bird-supper and beast conflict, dragon binding/millennium, final release/conflict, and great-white-throne judgment
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: open heaven reveals named/unnamed rider and armies; sun angel summons birds and beast conflict ends; abyss angel binding/thrones/release/Gog-Magog lead to white throne, books, and second death
candidate_units.preference_basis: Rider victory, beast end, dragon binding/release, final conflict, and throne judgment form a complete conflict-to-judgment parent without deciding linearity, recurrence, or millennium semantics.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomizing rider names, sword, supper, beast, binding, thousand years, first resurrection, Gog/Magog, books, lake/fire, or death can select referents, chronology, recapitulation, millennium, judgment/violence policy, Christology, doctrine, or theology.

candidate_units.form: new-creation/city announcement, throne speech, bride-city tour/measurement/materials, nations/gates, river/tree/throne, seeing and reigning close
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: new heaven/earth and descending city receive throne interpretation; bowl angel shows bride-city, measures and catalogs it; no-temple/nations/gates lead to river/tree/throne and eternal-light close
candidate_units.preference_basis: New creation, throne interpretation, bride-city tour, measurement/material catalogue, nations/gates, and river-tree-throne close comprise one vision-tour parent; reliable-words testimony begins the epilogue at 22:6.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Isolating sea, city/bride, peoples, exclusions, measurements, gems, temple, nations, gates, river, tree, face, or reign can create literal/allegorical systems, geography, ethnic/ecclesial referents, exclusion policy, chronology, doctrine, or theology.

candidate_units.form: reliable-words testimony, coming/blessing sayings, worship correction, unsealed-prophecy commands, identity/invitation, scroll warning, final testimony/prayer/benediction
candidate_units.span_specific_marker: reliable-and-true certification and coming blessing move through narrator/angel correction and seal-not command, recompense/identity sayings, Spirit-bride invitation, add/remove warning, come prayer, and grace close
candidate_units.preference_basis: Testimony, commands, worship correction, coming/identity sayings, invitation, warning, response, and benediction form one epilogue while preserving speaker ambiguity and finer routes.
candidate_units.downstream_misuse_risk: Atomizing speakers, soon, ethical-state saying, washing/commandment variant, outside list, invitation, add/remove warning, or coming prayer can choose readings, chronology, canon rule, salvation/exclusion policy, Christology, doctrine, or theology.

hardest_seams.why: Seven-message hearing refrain closes the commissioned oracle set and open-heaven doorway resets to throne vision; preserve 1-3/4-8 without a church-age chronology.
Sealing/multitude answer the sixth-seal question and seventh-seal silence closes the cycle before trumpet angels appear; preserve 4:1-8:1 and begin next parent at 8:2.
Sixth-trumpet result/reaction gives way to mighty-angel interlude that still delays the seventh trumpet; keep interlude inside 8:2-11:19.
Opened temple/ark theophany closes seventh trumpet and great sign begins a new symbolic-conflict movement; no chronology or recapitulation ruling follows.
Vintage closes sign-conflict harvests and another great/marvelous sign opens bowl completion; preserve both larger parents.
Seventh bowl names Babylon/theophany, then a bowl angel offers extended woman/city interpretation; keep cycle and interpretation-lament parent distinct but related.
Marriage supper dialogue/worship correction closes hallelujah movement and open heaven launches rider vision; preserve formal reset without identifying referents.
White-throne judgment closes conflict/judgment and new heaven/earth opens renewal; retain both parents and the larger judgment-to-renewal alternative without system selection.
River/tree/throne tour closes with seeing/reigning, and reliable-words certification begins epilogue; preserve 21:1-22:5/22:6-21.

premortem: Do not keep 22 chapter fallbacks or atomize every verse, kai, title, symbol, hymn line, numbered opening, list item, lament, or epilogue saying; preserve nine larger vision parents and functional subunits.

Do not detach oracle evaluation from call/promise, hymn from throne/vision, numbered act from cycle/interlude, sign from interpretation, warning from response, lament from refrain, city catalogue from tour, or epilogue saying from testimony/warning.

Do not turn Torah, Isaiah, Ezekiel, Daniel, Zechariah, Psalms, Gospel, or epistle echoes into source/dependence, fulfillment, referent, chronology, recapitulation, millennium, canon, doctrine, theology, graph, retrieval, or boundary truth.

Do not let Second Temple apocalypse/throne/angel, Greco-Roman civic-imperial, later rabbinic, or patristic evidence override Revelation or select date, history, source, system, policy, fulfillment, chronology, recapitulation, millennium, canon, doctrine, theology, or seams.

Do not identify angels, assemblies, seals, horsemen, witnesses, woman/child/dragon, beasts, mark/number, 144,000, Babylon, kings, Armageddon, rider, millennium, Gog/Magog, city/bride, nations, speakers, or modern political/religious entities.
Do not choose 1:5, 5:9-10, 13:18 (666/616), 16:5, 20:5, 21:24, 22:14, speaker, grace, or other textual readings; keep textual pressure inside larger parents.
Do not use Revelation to authorize empire/state/economic/violence/war/church/exclusion/survival policy, date calculations, fear marketing, or one eschatological system.
Keep every route LOW, deferred, candidate-only, non-authorizing, and without forced consensus; exact alternatives remain live.
